rule.text: A district appears when the jobs in its industries have a location quotient (the metro's share of jobs in them divided by the national share) of at least 1.25 and number at least 1,000 or 1% of the metro's jobs, or when one of its listed specialities has a location quotient of at least 3 with at least 5,000 jobs or 0.5% of the metro's jobs (and never fewer than 1,000). Districts are ranked by how many jobs they have above the national norm (jobs minus jobs divided by the quotient); up to 5 per city. A Harbor also needs a metro hex on or next to water or a mapped river. Metro jobs add up the member counties (BLS publishes metros as totals only from 2025 on); counties BLS withheld are left out, so such values are lower bounds. The city type is named after the strongest district, or after a listed district with a quotient of at least 6 and at least 3% of the metro's jobs when there is one, and labelled by its speciality when one passes; 'Seat of government' and 'Capital city' go only to metros holding a state capital or the national capital. When BLS withholds the Campus jobs but R1 research universities enrol students numbering at least 15% of the metro's population (IPEDS 12-month headcount, which includes online students), the city type is 'College town'.
rule.county_note: County districts use the same rule without the Harbor water test.

catalog.name: Campus
catalog.description: Science and technology: research labs, colleges and universities, software publishers, computer services and data hosting.

catalog.name: Commercial hub
catalog.description: Finance and insurance: banks, securities and commodity trading, insurers.

catalog.name: Industrial zone
catalog.description: Manufacturing plus oil and gas extraction and coal mining (the strategy-game home of power plants).

catalog.name: Harbor
catalog.description: Water transport: shipping and barge lines, and port and harbour services (cargo handling, pilots, marinas).
catalog.caveat: Only for metros with a hex on or next to water or a mapped river.

catalog.name: Theater square
catalog.description: Culture and media: theatres, orchestras, spectator sports, film and music studios, broadcasters.

catalog.name: Entertainment complex
catalog.description: Leisure: theme parks, casinos, golf, ski and fitness, plus hotels and resorts. Casino hotels count as hotels (NAICS 721120).

catalog.name: Aerodrome
catalog.description: Aviation: airlines, airport services and aerospace manufacturing.

catalog.name: Government plaza
catalog.description: Federal and state public administration (NAICS 92 without national security). Local government offices are in every county and are left out.
catalog.caveat: State universities and hospitals are not public administration (they count in Campus).

catalog.name: Encampment
catalog.description: National security: civilian Department of Defense staff and state National Guard employees.
catalog.caveat: Civilian defense staff only: uniformed troops are not in QCEW (see the Military layer).

catalog.name: Aqueduct & dam
catalog.description: Utilities: electric power generation and distribution, water, sewage and gas.
